title: Czech IT & Data job collector to Notion

sources.title: Job boards
sources.description: Which Czech job boards to crawl.

groupDataBi.title: Group: Data and BI
groupDataBi.description: Data analyst, data engineer, BI, ETL, data science.

groupBackendFrontend.title: Group: Backend and frontend
groupBackendFrontend.description: Backend, frontend, full stack, web and mobile developers.

groupDevopsCloud.title: Group: DevOps and cloud
groupDevopsCloud.description: DevOps, cloud, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, SRE, sysadmin.

groupSecurity.title: Group: Security
groupSecurity.description: Security engineer, SOC, penetration tester, cybersecurity.

groupItSupport.title: Group: IT support
groupItSupport.description: Helpdesk, service desk, technical and IT support.

groupProjectProduct.title: Group: Project and product management
groupProjectProduct.description: Project manager, product owner, scrum master, IT manager.

groupSapErp.title: Group: SAP and ERP
groupSapErp.description: SAP, ABAP, ERP, Oracle, Salesforce consultants.

customKeywords.title: Custom keywords
customKeywords.description: Extra words to match in the job title. An offer passes if it matches any enabled group or any of these words.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Your own words to drop offers by, e.g. 'senior' or 'praktikum'. Matched against the job title.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Upper limit of offers taken from each job board. Use a small number for test runs.

notionToken.title: Notion integration token
notionToken.description: Internal integration secret from notion.so/my-integrations. Stored as a secret in the Actor input.

notionDatabaseId.title: Notion database ID
notionDatabaseId.description: The 32-character ID from the database URL. The integration must be connected to this database.
